description: Build existing SCR observable-boot reset module against platform kernel source archive supplied under var/. Independently inspect vendor source, configuration, generated headers, symbol versions, build artifacts, and toolchain evidence. Pin selected module source and all build inputs. Build in disposable workspace outside var/ through managed LETS tooling. Deliver reproducible scr_reset_monitor.ko with compiler, source, ELF, release/vermagic, relocation, exported-symbol, and SHA-256 evidence. State any difference from previously observed running kernel without claiming hardware compatibility from offline evidence. Preserve original var/ bytes and metadata, unrelated main/legacy edits, prior REQ history, packages, and image quarantine. Scope excludes package/image installation, quarantine recovery, hardware access, module loading, reboot, reset-cause changes, and legacy requirement resumption.
idea: The var/ folder now contains the kernel sources of the exact HW platform. I want you to build the module against the kernel sources there. Create and run such SDLC item
